title: Overcoming Data Imbalances with Expert Selection Biases
abstract: arXiv:2610.13370v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models have become the standard architecture for frontier LLMs. The multiple parallel experts in each transformer block theoretically enable expert specialization according to categories such as domains, languages, or modalities during pretraining. However, when data is imbalanced across categories, minority categories can become concentrated in a small fraction of the expert pool or spread inefficiently across them, effectively limiting their available capacity. In this work, we demonstrate that category-conditioned expert-selection biases can preferentially route tokens from different categories toward specialized expert pools. By applying biases based on input category, we provide a simple way to induce soft category-aligned specialization. This intervention encourages categories toward distinct expert subsets while retaining cross-category sharing when useful. More importantly, it enables the over-allocation

translated_title: 利用专家选择偏差克服数据不平衡
translated_abstract: 混合专家模型已成为前沿大语言模型的标准架构。每个Transformer块中的多个并行专家在理论上能够在预训练期间实现专家按领域、语言或模态等类别进行专门化。然而，当数据在各类别之间分布不平衡时，少数类别可能会集中在专家池中的一小部分，或者在专家之间低效地分散，从而实际上限制了它们可用的模型容量。在这项工作中，我们证明了基于类别的专家选择偏差可以将来自不同类别的词元优先路由到专门的专家池。通过根据输入类别施加偏差，我们提供了一种诱导软性类别对齐专门化的简单方法。这种干预促使各类别趋向于不同的专家子集，同时在有用时保留跨类别的共享。更重要的是，它使得过度分配
tldr: 该论文提出在MoE模型中引入基于类别的专家选择偏差，将不同类别的词元优先路由到专门的专家子集，从而在数据类别不平衡的情况下实现软性类别对齐的专家专门化，有效缓解少数类别容量受限的问题。
en_tdlr: The paper proposes applying category-conditioned expert-selection biases in MoE models to preferentially route tokens from different categories toward specialized expert pools, enabling soft category-aligned specialization and mitigating capacity limitations for minority categories under data imbalance.
